signals_info.description: Time headway to the selected lead vehicle during moving ACC car-following.

nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 10 seconds, the time headway to the lead vehicle shall remain greater than 2 seconds.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 10 秒内，与前车的时间车头时距应始终大于 2 秒。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the 10-second ACC observation window, the vehicle shall continuously maintain more than 2 seconds of headway to the lead vehicle.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 10 秒的 ACC 跟车观测窗口内，车辆与前车应持续保持大于 2 秒的时间车头时距。
